title: Channelizer
text: Polyphase FFT analysis filter bank, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Number of frequency bands}, {DecimationFactor} sets the decimation factor Number of frequency, {Polyphase filter specification} sets the filter design parameters or coefficients Number of taps per band and stopband, {Number of filter taps per frequency band} sets the number of filter coefficients per frequency, {Stopband attenuation (dB)}, {Specify coefficients from input port} sets the flag to specify lowpass filter, {Prototype lowpass filter coefficients} sets the coefficients of prototype lowpass filter, {Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals}, {Bands as separate output ports (Max. of 16 bands)} sets the output frequency bands on separate output and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: x
ports.summary: Broadband signal L -by-1 column vector | L -by- N matrix

ports.name: coeffs
ports.summary: Prototype lowpass filter coefficients row vector

ports.name: Output(s)
ports.summary: Multiple narrowband signals vector | matrix | 3-D array

params.name: Number of frequency bands
params.values: Number of frequency bands 8 (default) | positive integer greater than 1

params.name: DecimationFactor
params.values: Decimation factor Number of frequency bands (default) | positive integer

params.name: Polyphase filter specification
params.values: Filter design parameters or coefficients Number of taps per band and stopband attenuation (default) | Coefficients

params.name: Number of filter taps per frequency band
params.values: Number of filter coefficients per frequency band 12 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Specify coefficients from input port
params.values: Flag to specify lowpass filter coefficients off (default) | on

params.name: Prototype lowpass filter coefficients
params.values: Coefficients of prototype lowpass filter rcosdesign(0.25,6,8,’sqrt’) (default) | row vector

params.name: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals
params.values: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals off (default) | on

params.name: Bands as separate output ports (Max. of 16 bands)
params.values: Output frequency bands on separate output ports off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
